text:
### Data Controllers (Receive Data)  
**Recipients of Customer Data:**
- Regulatory authorities (FCA, PRA, NCA)
- Law enforcement (if court order)
- Credit reference agencies (if credit product)
- Third-party service providers (with DPA)  
**Data Sharing Restrictions:**
- Only shared where lawful basis exists
- Shared only with necessary recipients
- International transfers (to EEA countries only, currently)

name: Chunk 24/36

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Authority
raw_entities.description: External regulatory bodies including the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), and National Crime Agency (NCA) that receive customer data as recipients under lawful basis. These authorities exercise regulatory oversight and financial crime investigation functions.

raw_entities.name: Law Enforcement
raw_entities.description: Law enforcement agencies that receive customer data only upon presentation of a court order. This represents a conditional data sharing obligation triggered by judicial process.

raw_entities.name: Credit Reference Agency
raw_entities.description: Third-party credit reference agencies that receive customer data when the customer holds a credit product. These entities process data for credit assessment and reporting purposes.

raw_entities.name: Third-Party Service Provider
raw_entities.description: External service providers that receive customer data under a Data Processing Agreement (DPA). These entities perform services on behalf of the bank subject to contractual data protection obligations.

raw_entities.name: Data Sharing Only Where Lawful Basis Exists
raw_entities.description: Provision requiring that customer data is shared only when a lawful basis under data protection law exists. This establishes the foundational legal requirement for all data sharing activities.
context: Only shared where lawful basis exists

raw_entities.name: Data Sharing Limited to Necessary Recipients
raw_entities.description: Provision restricting customer data sharing to only those recipients whose receipt is necessary for the stated purpose. This implements the data minimisation principle.

raw_entities.name: International Data Transfer Restriction to EEA Countries
raw_entities.description: Provision limiting international transfers of customer data to countries within the European Economic Area (EEA) only, currently. This reflects adequacy requirements under data protection law.
context: International transfers (to EEA countries only, currently)

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Data Disclosure
raw_entities.description: Risk of customer data being shared with recipients lacking lawful basis or necessity, or transferred to jurisdictions outside the permitted scope. This represents a compliance and privacy violation risk.
context: Only shared where lawful basis exists
